intent: Record as reviewed the source, plugin member, test case and download lifetime rules the packaging Context enforces and tests.
observable_outcome: get-context packaging lists the rules as reviewed, each proven by its test.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A package is refused when SKILL.md points at a file or directory the packager leaves out, since the download would miss what its own instructions use.
A stored source that now fails import validation is not packaged, except for errors inside a directory the packager leaves out anyway.
A plugin member whose version belongs to another Skill is answered not found, so one Skill's gates never apply to another's content.
A package built for a recipient never selects test cases, whatever the include flag says.
When the user opts out of test cases, even curated cases stay out and are listed as user_opted_out.
A test case from an uncurated source that carries a dataset stays out of the package as user_uploaded_dataset; one without a dataset stays out as not_curated.
Deleting a download removes its stored object only when no other live artifact shares it.
A package is not served once it has expired, been purged or is not scan-available.
A package expires exactly the configured retention after it is built.
